## Scientific outreach

```{r outreach}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

outreach <- tribble(
  ~Institution, ~Title, ~Year,
  "Fortnightly cartoonist for Ecology for the Masses blog",  "Cartoonist", "2020 - 2022",
  "Q&A sessions with school groups",  "Skype a Scientist", "2024 - Present",
  "Pen pal programme with school students",  "Letters to a PreScientist", "2025 - Present",
)

cv_entries(outreach, with = "Title", when = "Year",
           what = "Institution")
```
